title: A Cherry-Picking Approach to Large Load Shaping for More Effective Carbon Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2601.17990v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Shaping multi-megawatt flexible loads such as data centers alters generator dispatch on the electric grid, affecting system-wide CO2 emissions and wholesale electricity costs. However, evaluating prevalent load-shaping signals - such as grid-average carbon intensity, locational marginal price, renewable generation, or commercial marginal emission estimates - has remained difficult because full-scale market-clearing models and generator bid data are rarely accessible outside system operators. Here we conduct year-long causal dispatch counterfactuals using a calibrated, nearly 8,900-bus replica of ERCOT's day-ahead Security Constrained Unit Commitment and Security Constrained Economic Dispatch market-clearing process across renewable-rich and fossil-dominated zones. We find that while LMP-based shaping outperforms other static signals in annual grid CO2 reductions, no single signal performs best across all operating conditions. M

translated_title: 一种“择优挑选”方法用于大规模负荷整形以实现更有效的碳减排
translated_abstract: 对数据中心等多兆瓦级柔性负荷进行整形会改变电网上的发电机调度，从而影响整个系统的二氧化碳排放和批发电力成本。然而，评估常见的负荷整形信号——例如电网平均碳强度、节点边际电价（LMP）、可再生能源发电量或商业边际排放估算——一直十分困难，因为完整规模的市场出清模型和发电机投标数据在系统运营商之外很少能够获得。本文利用经过校准的、近8900节点规模的ERCOT日前安全约束机组组合（SCUC）与安全约束经济调度（SCED）市场出清流程复现模型，在可再生能源丰富区和化石能源主导区开展了为期一年的因果调度反事实分析。我们发现，虽然基于LMP的负荷整形在年度电网CO2减排方面优于其他静态信号，但没有任何单一信号能在所有运行条件下均表现最佳。
tldr: 本文通过构建近8900节点的ERCOT日前市场出清流程校准复现模型进行全年因果调度反事实分析，发现基于节点边际电价的负荷整形在年度电网碳减排中优于其他静态信号，但没有单一信号能在所有运行条件下均表现最佳，因而提出择优选择信号的负荷整形策略以实现更有效的碳减排。
